title: 2-Pair MisGAN: 8D MCAR p=0.50 Coordinate Missingness
intuition: Recovers a 100-mode 2D manifold embedded in 8D when 50% of coordinates are randomly missing completely at random (MCAR), testing simultaneous data manifold and mask distribution recovery.
failure_mode: High coordinate dropout blurs the 8D subspace constraint (off_plane > 0.05) and reduces recovered modes below 90/100.
protocol_notes: Tier-4 stretch benchmark (4,000 updates, empty masks resampled).
